final_resume.summary: B.Tech graduate with a backend internship building Java and Spring Boot REST services, with strong data structures and algorithms practice.

projects.name: ShopEase - E-commerce Store
projects.description: Architected Spring Boot REST backend with MySQL database and React storefront, deployed on AWS EC2 with S3 image storage. Implemented cart, checkout, and order history features supporting full-stack e-commerce workflow.

bullets: Built 6 REST endpoints in Spring Boot for the order-returns module backed by MySQL, enabling seamless product return workflows.
Wrote JUnit tests for the returns service, raising module coverage from 45% to 70% and improving code quality.
Debugged and resolved 12 production issues reported by the support team, demonstrating strong problem-solving and system troubleshooting skills.

profile_improvement_tips: Learn and build a project in Python or JavaScript to match the JD's core language requirements; both are heavily weighted in Google hiring.
Study and practise system design concepts (scalability, load balancing, caching, databases) through LeetCode or Grokking the System Design Interview; document a design in your resume.
Gain hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services (Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub) via a personal project or certification; this is a direct match for the role.
Contribute to an open-source project or internal codebase review process to demonstrate code review and collaborative development practices.
Explore NLP or distributed systems through a hobby project or course (e.g., building a simple recommendation engine or multi-service architecture) to broaden your technical depth.
final_resume.growth_note: You are a strong fresher with solid Java and backend fundamentals, but the JD requires 1+ year of professional experience and familiarity with multiple languages (Python, JavaScript, C++) and advanced topics (distributed systems, system design, GCP). Your internship is a good foundation; prioritise gaining 1 year of professional experience and learning the missing languages and GCP to be a competitive candidate.
